entities.name: Query protein (365 aa)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5FPS6 from Gluconobacter oxydans; identity and coverage are both 100%.
Predicted molecular mass is 38,109 Da, theoretical pI 5.52, and charge at pH 7 is approximately −10.45.
Contains Pfam TsaD domain PF00814.32 at residues 35–328.
The C-terminal region around residues 340–365 is annotated as disordered in the exact reference protein.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, exact homology, domain and reference-feature evidence

entities.name: Q5FPS6
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein annotated as tRNA N6-adenosine threonylcarbamoyltransferase (TsaD).
Acts with TsaB and TsaE in formation of t6A37 in tRNAs reading codons beginning with adenine.
Binds one Fe(2+) ion per subunit; EC 2.3.1.234; cytoplasmic localization.

source_tools.relevance: Curated functional annotation and cofactor evidence

entities.name: t6A37 formation
observations: L-threonylcarbamoyladenylate is transferred to adenosine 37 in tRNA, producing N6-L-threonylcarbamoyladenosine 37 in tRNA plus AMP and H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:37059, with related mappings RHEA:10162 and RHEA:10163.

entities.name: tRNA t6A37 modification
observations: Biological process is tRNA threonylcarbamoyladenosine modification, GO:0002949.
Molecular functions include tRNA N6-L-threonylcarbamoyladenine synthase activity (GO:0061711) and iron ion binding (GO:0005506).
